body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2025-07-29 (Q1FY26 concall transcript): "The 500-megawatt solar project in Karnataka has been partly commissioned and is scheduled for completion next quarter" Metric: Project completion. Target: by Q2FY26. Deadline: 2025-09-30. Specificity: precise; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-21: missed. Evidence: Nov-25: 'scheduled for completion this quarter' (Q3); Jan-26: 'within this quarter' (Q4); May-26: 1,000 MW across Karnataka and Rajasthan commissioned. Two quarters late; slips not acknowledged.
